meta.name: company-events
meta.description: Company event signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about M&A signals, company expansion, new locations, IPO, product launches, leadership changes, headquarters moves, mergers, acquisitions, or firmographic triggers. Do NOT use for funding rounds (use funding skill) or hiring signals (use hiring skill).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪公司事件信号，发现 B2B 销售机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要监控目标公司的并购、扩张、领导层变更等信号来驱动销售。
copy.tagline_en: Track company event signals to uncover B2B sales opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor M&A, expansion, leadership changes, etc., to drive sales.

howto.what: 装上后，当你询问公司事件信号时，Claude 能追踪并购、扩张、IPO、产品发布、领导层变动等事件，并根据事件类型打分（如IPO得50分），给出最佳联系窗口（如并购后72小时内）。它还可以通过ColdIQ或Crunchbase等来源自动检测信号。
howto.when: 当你提到并购、扩张、IPO等公司事件信号时触发。注意不要用于融资轮次或招聘信号（另有单独技能）。

say.text: 帮我监控目标公司的并购活动
say.note: Claude会搜索并购事件并给出分数和联系建议

say.text: 这家公司刚开了新办公室，帮我分析
say.note: Claude会识别为新地点事件，得分25分，并给出拓展建议
Claude会查找IPO事件，得分50分，提示合规需求

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude tracks company event signals such as M&A, expansion, IPO, product launches, and leadership changes. It scores events (e.g., IPO = 50 pts) and suggests optimal outreach windows (e.g., within 72h for M&A). It can detect signals via ColdIQ, Crunchbase, or other sources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about M&A, expansion, IPO, or similar firmographic triggers. Do not use for funding rounds or hiring signals (separate skills).

say_en.text: Monitor M&A activity for my target accounts
say_en.note: Claude searches for M&A events, scores them, and provides outreach advice

say_en.text: This company just opened a new office, analyze it
say_en.note: Claude identifies as new location event, scores 25 pts, and gives expansion tips
Claude finds IPO events, scores 50 pts, and highlights compliance needs
